tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha las gud du phyung ba dzaṃ bha la nyi shu rtsa gcig gi g.yang skyabs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

'di ni rgyun du nor lha'i gtor ma la brten nas bton yang rung*/ bskang ba'i gral bton yang rung*/ don la las byang gsol ka skong bshags thams cad tshang bar yod/ tshar lnga bton na g.yang skyabs brgya tshar gyi go chod par 'gyur ro// na mo rat+na gu ru ār+ya dzaṃ bha la ye/ gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs dus lo nyes phyugs nad god kha sogs// lha srin 'khrugs pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyis// mi g.yang lo g.yang sa yi bcud nyams dus// 'gro la phan phyir g.yang skyabs khyer bde ba// gnam chos las byung dzam lha'i sgrub pa rnams// ngag 'don 'bri la srung mas bka' gnang stsol// bca' thabs rgyas par g.yang skyabs gzhan dang mthun// bsdu na gzhi dkar nas kyi 'dab brgyad steng*// gtor ma nor bu'i dbyibs la pad 'dab bskor// mar gyi me tog thud kyi ril bus brgyan// lha mda' leb mar rgod sgro dar sna btags// g.yang sgye ge lu dkar po'i nang du ni// phyug po'i 'bru dang g.yang spu ci 'dzom bsags// phye mar la sogs zas sna gang 'dzom bshams// bdag skyed yi dam gang rung gzhung bsrangs nas// rgyas par byed na dzaṃ lha'i las byang ni// gnam chos gzhung las byung ba btang nas kyang*// g.yang glud glud gtor lan chags tshim byed gtang*// de nas rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// lcang lo can nas dzaṃ lha so so rnams// spyan drangs gnas 'dir rtag tu bzhugs nas kyang*// rang ngam sbyin bdag de la phywa g.yang gi /dngos grub sna tshogs char du 'beb par bsam// mchod pa bran la bsang sbyang byin brlabs nas// gyer bsgom sbrags te rnga sogs rol mor bcas// oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod du mchod rdzas kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ gtor ma zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ hūm̐: bcom ldan dzaṃ dkar zhal gsum pa: g.yas zhal dmar la g.yon zhal sngo: phyag drug phyag mtshan 'di ltar ro: dang po gnyis kyis lcags kyu zhags: de 'og gnyis kyis nor bu dang: ne 'u le ni 'dzin pa 'o: tha ma gnyis kyi phyag na ni: bhan+dha dang ni nor bu 'dzin: zhabs bzhi pad zla'i gdan la bgrad: zhal ni gsum ka zhi ma khro: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: sangs rgyas kun gyi dpral ba dang*// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas// 'dir gshegs gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs// thugs kar zla steng dzaṃ yig dkar// sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /mi nor longs spyod phywa g.yang khug /rta phyugs spu nag phywa g.yang khug /lo thog 'bras drug phywa g.yang khug /da lta myur du 'dir 'dus shig /bkra shis byin chags 'dir 'dus shig /phyag mtshan rin chen ne'u le las// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho lta bur skyil du gsol// bar snang char bzhin 'beb tu gsol// 'gyur med sku yi phywa g.yang stsol// g.yang bshos zas phud mchod gtor bzhes// ja chang skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod// g.yang rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// ma byin len dang ser sna bshags// rtag tu 'byor pa phun tshogs nas// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par mdzod// hūm̐: bcom ldan dzaṃ dmar zhal gsum pa: g.yas zhal de ni dkar po la: g.yon zhal de ni nag po 'o: phyag drug dang po gnyis kyis ni: bhan+dha dang ni ne 'u le: de 'og gi ni phyag gnyis na: lcags kyu dang ni zhags pa 'dzin: de 'og gnyis na nor bu dang: ne 'u le ni 'dzin pa 'o: zhabs bzhi de ni bgrad pa 'o: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// sangs rgyas kun gyi mgrin pa dang*// lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// 'dir gshegs gnas 'dir brtan par gzhugs// thugs kar zla steng dzaṃ yig dmar// sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig

/mi nor longs spyod phywa g.yang khug /rta phyugs spu nag phywa g.yang khug /lo thog 'bras drug phywa g.yang khug /da lta myur du 'dir 'dus shig /bkra shis byin chags 'dir 'dus shig /phyag mtshan thod nang rin chen dang*// ne 'u le gnyis skyugs pa las// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho lta bur skyil du gsol// bar snang char bzhin 'beb tu gsol// 'gag med gsung gi phywa g.yang stsol// g.yang bshos zas phud mchod gtor bzhes// ja chang skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod// g.yang rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// ma byin len dang ser sna bshags// rtag tu 'byor pa phun tshogs nas// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par mdzod// hūm̐: dzaṃ lha sngon po zhal gsum pa: g.yas zhal de ni dkar po la: g.yon zhal de ni dmar po 'o: phyag drug phyag mtshan 'di lta ste: dang po gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang: ne 'u le ni 'dzin pa 'o: de 'og lcags kyu zhags pa dang: tha gnyis ne'u le rab tu 'dzin: dar dang rin po che yis brgyan: zhabs bzhi de ni bgrad pa 'o: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs ka dang*// lcang lo can nas 'dir byon la// gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs su gsol// thugs kar zla steng dzaṃ yig sngo// sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /mi nor longs spyod phywa g.yang khug /rta phyugs spu nag phywa g.yang khug /lo thog 'bras drug phywa g.yang khug /da lta myur du 'dir 'dus shig /bkra shis byin chags 'dir 'dus shig /phyag mtshan ne'u le skyugs pa nas// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho lta bur skyil du gsol// bar snang char bzhin 'beb tu gsol// 'khrul med thugs kyi phywa g.yang stsol// g.yang bshos zas phud mchod gtor bzhes// ja chang skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod// g.yang rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// ma byin len dang ser sna bshags// rtag tu 'byor pa phun tshogs nas// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par mdzod// hūm̐:

bcom ldan 'phags pa dzaṃ ser ni: zhal gsum g.yas zhal dkar po la: g.yon zhal de ni dmar po 'o: phyag drug dang po gnyis kyis ni: lcags kyu zhags pa de 'og gnyis: nor bu ne'u le tha ma gnyis: nor bu bab le pang pa 'o: zhabs bzhi pad nyi'i gdan la bgrad: dar dang rin po che yis brgyan: sangs rgyas kun gyi lte ba dang*// rnam thos bu yi pho brang nas// 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs su gsol// thugs kar zla steng dzaṃ yig ser// sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /mi nor longs spyod phywa g.yang khug /rta phyugs spu nag phywa g.yang khug /lo thog 'bras drug phywa g.yang khug /da lta myur du 'dir 'dus shig /bkra shis byin chags 'dir 'dus shig /phyag mtshan nor bu ne'u le las// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho lta bur skyil du gsol// bar snang char bzhin 'beb tu gsol// yon tan re skong phywa g.yang stsol// g.yang bshos zas phud mchod gtor bzhes// ja chang skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod// g.yang rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// ma byin len dang ser sna bshags// rtag tu 'byor pa phun tshogs nas// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par mdzod// hūm̐: dzaṃ bha la ni sku mdog ljang: zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas zhal dkar: g.yon zhal de ni sngon po 'o: phyag drug phyag mtshan 'di ltar ro: dang po gnyis kyis bab le dang: ne 'u le ni btsir ba 'o: bar ma gnyis kyi phyag na ni: lcags kyu dang ni zhags pa 'dzin: de 'og gnyis kyi phyag na ni: rin chen zhags pa khyung rkyal 'dzin: khyung shun nor bus bkang ba 'o// zhabs bzhi de ni zla steng bgrad: zhal ni gsum ka zhi ma khro: dar dang rin po che yis brgyan: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gnas dang*// byang phyogs rin chen gzhal yas nas// 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs su gsol// thugs kar zla steng baṃ yig ljang*// sngags kyis bskor las 'od 'phros pas// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig

/mi nor longs spyod phywa g.yang khug /rta phyugs spu nag phywa g.yang khug /lo thog 'bras drug phywa g.yang khug /da lta myur du 'dir 'dus shig /bkra shis byin chags 'dir 'dus shig /phyag mtshan ne'u le khyung rkyal nas// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho lta bur skyil du gsol// bar snang char bzhin 'beb tu gsol// phrin las 'gro 'dul phywa g.yang stsol// g.yang bshos zas phud mchod gtor bzhes// ja chang skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod// g.yang rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// ma byin len dang ser sna bshags// rtag tu 'byor pa phun tshogs nas// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par mdzod// hūm̐: dzam bha la ni sku mdog nag: zhal gsum g.yas zhal dkar po la: g.yon zhal de ni dmar po 'o: phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po na: lcags kyu ne'u le de 'og na: nor bu zhags pa 'dzin pa 'o: tha gnyis 'brang rgyas bhan+dha 'dzin: zhabs bzhi pad zla'i gdan la bgrad: zhal ni gsum ka zhi ma khro: dar dang rin chen rgyan cha can: rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka dang*// lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs su gsol// thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ yig la// sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /mi nor longs spyod phywa g.yang khug /rta phyugs spu nag phywa g.yang khug /lo thog 'bras drug phywa g.yang khug /da lta myur du 'dir 'dus shig /bkra shis byin chags 'dir 'dus shig /phyag mtshan nor bu ne'u le las// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho lta bur skyil du gsol// bar snang char bzhin 'beb tu gsol// bla med mchog gi phywa g.yang stsol// g.yang bshos zas phud mchod gtor bzhes// ja chang skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod// g.yang rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// ma byin len dang ser sna bshags// rtag tu 'byor pa phun tshogs nas// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par mdzod// hūm̐:

dzam khra sku mdog 'di lta ste: sku lus phyed g.yas dkar po la: sku lus phyed g.yon dmar po 'o: zhal gsum g.yas zhal dmar po ste: g.yon zhal de ni ljang gu 'o: phyag drug dang po gnyis kyis ni: ne 'u le yi rkyal pa 'dzin: bar gnyis nor skyug pho mo btsir: tha ma g.yas kyis tshogs bdag btsir: tha ma g.yon gyi phyag na ni: gnod sbyin nor skyong btsir ba 'o: zhal ni gsum ka zhi ma khro: zhabs bzhi de ni bgrad pa 'o: dar dang rin po che yis brgyan: zhabs bzhi pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: chos sku kun bzang mkha' klong dang*// byang phyogs rin chen gzhal yas nas// 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs su gsol// thugs dbus zla steng dzaṃ yig khra// sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /mi nor longs spyod phywa g.yang khug /rta phyugs spu nag phywa g.yang khug /lo thog 'bras drug phywa g.yang khug /da lta myur du 'dir 'dus shig /bkra shis byin chags 'dir 'dus shig /phyag mtshan ne'u le tshogs bdag dang*// nor skyug pho mo btsir ba las// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho lta bur skyil du gsol// bar snang char bzhin 'beb tu gsol// dgos 'dod yid bzhin phywa g.yang stsol// g.yang bshos zas phud mchod gtor bzhes// ja chang skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod// g.yang rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// ma byin len dang ser sna bshags// rtag tu 'byor pa phun tshogs nas// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par mdzod// hūm̐: dzaṃ bha la ni sku mdog ni: dbu dang phyag g.yas dkar po 'o: zhabs dang phyag g.yon dmar po 'o: de min sku mdog ser po 'o: zhal gsum g.yas zhal dkar po la: g.yon zhal de ni dmar po 'o: phyag drug phyag mtshan 'di lta ste: dang po gnyis kyis lcags kyu zhags: de 'og gnyis kyis ne 'u le:

tha ma gnyis kyis zhags pa dang: nor bu de ni 'dzin pa 'o: zhabs bzhi de ni bgrad pa 'o: dar dang rin po che yis brgyan: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing khams nas// 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs su gsol// thugs kar pad zlar dzaṃ yig khra// de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /mi nor longs spyod phywa g.yang khug /rta phyugs spu nag phywa g.yang khug /lo thog 'bras drug phywa g.yang khug /da lta myur du 'dir 'dus shig /bkra shis byin chags 'dir 'dus shig /phyag mtshan nor bu ne'u le las// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho lta bur skyil du gsol// bar snang char bzhin 'beb tu gsol// 'dzad med gter gyi phywa g.yang stsol// g.yang bshos zas phud mchod gtor bzhes// ja chang skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod// g.yang rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// ma byin len dang ser sna bshags// rtag tu 'byor pa phun tshogs nas// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par mdzod// hūm̐: dzaṃ khra'i sku mdog 'di lta ste: dbu ni dkar po zhabs g.yon dkar: lto ba ser po zhabs g.yas ljang: de min lus dang gru mo dmar: gru mo phan gyi phyag bcas rnams: ljang gu yin pa dzaṃ khra'i lugs: zhal gsum g.yas zhal sngon po 'o: g.yon zhal de ni smug po yin: phyag drug phyag mtshan 'di lta ste: rdo rje dang ni ne 'u le: be con dang ni ral gri dang: rin chen ne'u le 'dzin pa 'o: zhabs bzhi de ni pad steng bgrad: dar dang rin po che yis brgyan: yum ni ser mos sku la 'khyud: lha mi bde skyid zhing khams dang*// rin chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas// 'dir gshegs gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs// thugs kar zla steng dzaṃ yig khra// sngags kyis bskor las 'od 'phros pas// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig

/mi nor longs spyod phywa g.yang khug /rta phyugs spu nag phywa g.yang khug /lo thog 'bras drug phywa g.yang khug /da lta myur du 'dir 'dus shig /bkra shis byin chags 'dir 'dus shig /phyag mtshan rin chen ne'u le las// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho lta bur skyil du gsol// bar snang char bzhin 'beb tu gsol// bkra shis bde skyid phywa g.yang stsol// g.yang bshos zas phud mchod gtor bzhes// ja chang skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod// g.yang rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// ma byin len dang ser sna bshags// rtag tu 'byor pa phun tshogs nas// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par mdzod// hūm̐: dbus su dzam lha sku mdog sngo: g.yas g.yon 'khor lo nor bu 'dzin: pad+ma nyi steng bzhengs te bzhugs: shar 'khor sku mdog dkar po ste: lag gnyis rdo rje'i phyag rgya mdzad: lho 'khor sku mdog ser po ste: lag gnyis nor bu'i phyag rgya mdzad: nub 'khor sku mdog dmar po ste: lag gnyis pad+ma'i phyag rgya mdzad: byang 'khor sku mdog ljang gu ste: lag gnyis ral gri'i phyag rgya mdzad: shar lho'i 'khor ni sku mdog ser: lag gnyis me lce'i phyag rgya mdzad: lho nub 'khor ni sku mdog dkar: lag gnyis chu yi phyag rgya mdzad: nub byang 'khor ni sku mdog dmar: lag gnyis sa yi phyag rgya mdzad: byang shar 'khor ni sku mdog ljang: lag gnyis shing gi phyag rgya mdzad: gtso 'khor thams cad cha lugs mthun: zhabs rnams thams cad 'dor thabs bzhugs: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: dbus kyi dzaṃ lha gtso 'khor dgu// dbus phyogs 'og min gnas nas byon// steng gi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang*// sbrang char bzhin du 'beb cing byon// tshangs pa lha yi phywa g.yang khug /ri bo'i rtse nas phywa g.yang khug /dar po'i dar g.yang 'dir khug cig:
